resolution_note: membrane and rays are not resolved by any grid here; VLM models each fin as a zero-thickness surface (the approximation), so no thickness or ray stiffness enters

regimes.note: VLM is inviscid and Re-independent; validity needs attached flow (thin boundary layers, small alpha). The listed Re only say which real regime a dCp would be converted for.
